question: Whose autobiography is titled 'Sunny Days'?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sunil Gavaskar.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Sunny Days"** is an **autobiography** written by Sunil Gavaskar.
 
• **Sunil Manohar Gavaskar **is an Indian **cricket commentator and former player** who played for India and Bombay between **1971 and 1987.** Gavaskar is regarded as** one of the all-time great opening batters.**
 
• Gavaskar has been awarded the** Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan**, two of India's highest civilian honours.
 
• In **2009**, he was recognised into the **International Cricket Council's (ICC) Cricket Hall of Fame.**
 
• In** 2012**, the **Col CK Nayudu Lifetime Achievement Award** for Cricket in India was bestowed upon him.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sourav Chandidas Ganguly**__

 __
 
• Also known as** Dada,** is an** Indian cricket administrator, commentator, and former national team captain **who currently serves as the **president of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).**
 
• He is known as the** Maharaja of Indian Cricket.**
 
• Ganguly established himself as one of the** best batsmen** in the world and one of** the most successful captains **of the Indian national cricket team during his playing career.
 
• He was particularly productive through the **off side while batting**, receiving the moniker **"God of the Off Side"** for his graceful stroke play square of the wicket and through the covers.
 
• 
 
Ganguly was awarded the** Padma Shri in 2004. ** Ganguly was awarded the **Banga Bibhushan Award** from the **Government of West Bengal **on** 20 May 2013.** "**A Century is Not Enough" Book is** Ganguly's story of monumental challenges.

 
 
 
 
• **Sachin Ramesh Tendulkar**__
 __
 
• He is a **former Indian cricket captain** who captained the Indian national team. He is widely recognised as one of the **best batsmen **in cricket history.
 
• **Wisden** voted him the** second-greatest Test batsman **of all time, behind** Don Bradman**, and the second greatest** ODI batsman** of all time, behind **Viv Richards, in 2002**, halfway through his career.
 
• Tendulkar earned the** Arjuna Award **for excellent athletic achievements in** 1994,** the **Khel Ratna Award,** India's highest sporting honour, in **1997,** the **Padma Shri and Padma Vibhushan** medals in **1999, **and the** Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award, in** 2014.**
 
• At the** 2010 ICC Awards**, Tendulkar received the **Sir Garfield Sobers Trophy for cricketer of the year.**
 
• **"Playing It My Way"** is the autobiography of Sachin Tendulkar.
 
 
 
• **Anil Kumble**__
 
 
• ​Anil Kumble is a former** Indian cricket coach and commentator **who played Test and One Day International cricket for his country throughout the course of his 18-year international career.
 
• He got** 619 wickets in Test cricket** and is the** fourth-highest**** **wicket-taker of all time as of **2022**. He is widely recognised as one of the** top leg-spin bowlers in Test cricket history.**
 
• Kumble is now the** Punjab Kings' Head Coach** and** Director of Cricket Operations.**​
 
• **"​Wide Angle: Candid Moments From My Playing Days"** book is written by Anil Kumble.
